title: Fish Kofta
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Namak (Salt) ½ tsp or to taste
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) ½ tsp or to taste
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) ½ tbs
Adrak lehsan paste (Ginger garlic paste) 1 tsp
Lal mirch powder (Red chili powder) 1 tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: In boiling water,place strainer,add fresh water fish and boil for 3-4 minutes then strain & let it cool.
steps.romanUrdu: Boiling pan mein strainer rakh dein aur machi dal ker 3-4 miutes kliya boil ker lein phir strain ker ka thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: Remove fish bones & set aside the remaining fish meat in a bowl.
steps.romanUrdu: Fish bones ko nikal lein aur ek bowl mein machli ka meat ko dal dein.

steps.instruction: Add onion,green chili,gram flour,salt,red chili powder,turmeric powder,ginger garlic paste,carom seeds, fresh coriander,egg and mix until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz,hari mirch,baisan,namak,lal mirch powder,haldee powder,adrak lehsan paste,ajwain,hara dhania aur anda dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Take a mixture and makes fish koftay of equal sizes (makes 12).
steps.romanUrdu: Mixture ko lein aur ek jaisay sizes ka fish ka koftay tayyar ker lein (makes 12).

steps.instruction: In wok,heat cooking oil and fry koftay and fry until golden.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein cooking oil garam karein aur fish kofton ko golden hunay tak fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add cooking oil,green cardamom,cloves,cinnamon sticks and mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein cooking oil,hari elaichi,laung aur darchini dal ker mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add onion,mix well and cook until light brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur light brown hunay tak fry ker lein.
Tamatar dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add ginger garlic paste and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Adrak lehsan paste dal ker mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,turmeric powder,red chili powder and mix well for 2-3 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak,haldee powder aur lal mirch powder dal ker 2-3 minutes kliya ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add grinded almond and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Grinded badam dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add water,mix well and bring it to boil.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani shamil karein aur ubal anay dein.

steps.instruction: Now add fried fish koftay and mix gently.
steps.romanUrdu: Fried fish ka koftay dal ker gently mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add green chili and fresh coriander,cover and cook on low flame for 2-3 minutes & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Hari mirch aur hara dhania dal ker dhak dein aur halki ancch per 2-3 minutes kliya paka lein aur serve karein.
